Vilvah is an Indian natural beauty brand known for goat milk and botanical formulas for face, hair and body. Swansura is an official UK partner of Vilvah, so every product is genuine and ships from the UK. We stock a wide range of Vilvah products, from single bottles to full kits.

Where to start

Vilvah Milk Drops, the brightening serum, is the place most people begin. You will also find it in the Milk Face Kit (£45.99) with the Milk Mud Mask. For hair, the Vilvah Goat Milk Shampoo 250ML (£15.99) cleanses without stripping natural moisture and helps soften dry strands. Pair it with the Vilvah conditioner, the Cream Conditioner 250ML (£15.99), for smoother, more manageable hair. The Herbal Shampoo 250ML (£15.99) is made for a flaky scalp.

Face care

Each Vilvah face wash suits a different skin. The Honey Face Wash 100ml (£12.99) contains 10% raw honey and fruit extracts, the Fragrance-Free Cream Face Wash 100ml (£9.99) is gentle and plant-based, and the Milk Powder Face Wash 50g (£13.99) is a water-free powder with hyaluronic acid. For a Vilvah face mask, choose Wild Rose with French pink clay (£11.99) or Charcoal with aloe vera (£12.99). Skin Finish Sunscreen SPF 50 PA+++ (£17.99) leaves a soft, natural finish.

Kits and extras

Kits bundle a routine in one box, from the Lip Nourishing Kit (£13.99) to the Goat Milk Hair Kit (£34.99). Natural Deo Shots and the Natural Lip Scrub (£6.99) round out the range. Browse the Goat milk range, shampoo, face wash and cleanser or natural sunscreen. Every Vilvah UK order over £40 ships free.

A lip scrub is the simplest way to lift dry, flaky skin so your lips feel smooth again. We stock three natural sugar-based exfoliators from Deyga and Vilvah, from £6.99, each small enough to keep in a bag or bedside drawer.

Three scrubs to choose from

Deyga's mint scrub (16 g, £12.99) is a gentle exfoliator that buffs away dead skin and leaves lips feeling cool and fresh. The strawberry version from Deyga (16 g, £10.99) uses granulated sugar to polish away rough patches, with a fruity scent that makes the routine feel like a small pleasure. Vilvah's Natural Lip Scrub (10 g, £6.99) is the lightest of the three, with lemon essential oil to brighten the look of your lip tone.

How to use it

Use a small amount on clean, dry lips. Massage in slow circles for 30 seconds, then wipe away with a damp cloth or rinse off. Two or three times a week is plenty for most people, and a little more often in cold weather when lips tend to feel tight. Go gently if your lips are chapped or cracked.

Always follow your scrub with a nourishing balm to seal in moisture. A natural lip balm such as Deyga's beetroot lip balm adds a soft flush of colour, while an SPF lip balm is a good daytime choice. You'll find them all in our lip balm for dry lips edit and the wider lip care collection. Small scrubs also make easy stocking fillers.

Swansura is an official UK partner of Deyga and Vilvah. Every product is 100% authentic, posted from the UK, and delivery is free when you spend over £40.

Rose water toner

For him

Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum blends grapefruit, cardamom and ginger with tobacco, amber and cedarwood. Choose 100ml at £54.99 or 150ml at £69.99. The One for Men Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml (£54.99) goes deeper with neroli, cashmeran, benzoin and leather, and The One Gold for Men Eau de Parfum Intense (£54.99) adds aromatic spice. The K Eau de Parfum Gift Set 50ml + 5ml (£54.99) is fresh, herbal and woody.

Al Haramain Amber Oud is the collection that made this Arabian perfume house famous, and you will find many of its editions here. These are warm, long-lasting eaux de parfum, each with its own twist on amber.

The Amber Oud editions

The Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Edition (from £32.99) opens with melon and pineapple before a creamy amber and vanilla base. The Amber Oud Tobacco Edition 60ml (£32.99) is sweeter and spicier, with tobacco and woods. Ruby (from £41.99) brings saffron and jasmine, Black (100ml, £39.99) is smoky with leather and resins, Bleu (from £38.99) is fresh and aromatic, and Carbon (from £35.99) is a clean, green take for men. White Edition, the original Amber Oud 60ml and Amber Musk 100ml are here too, plus the Extreme Gold Edition Extrait de Parfum from £36.99.

L'Aventure and Detour Noir

The Al Haramain L'Aventure line offers fresher 100ml bottles from £29.99. The original L'Aventure (£29.99) is clean and citrusy, while Al Haramain L'Aventure Intense (£39.99) adds elemi, jasmine and patchouli. L'Aventure Gold and L'Aventure Femme suit women who like fruity florals, and L'Aventure Blanche is a crisp unisex option. Al Haramain Detour Noir 100ml (£19.99) is a warm blend of vanilla, lavender and almond.

Compare these with other Arabian perfume or browse the full oud fragrances edit. If you enjoy this style, Signature D'orient is worth a look. Every Al Haramain perfume we sell is 100% authentic and ships from our UK base, with free UK delivery on orders over £40.

A darker kind of rose

Serge Lutens La Fille de Berlin Eau de Parfum 50ml is £44.99. It is built around a dark, velvety rose accord, sharpened with pepper and settled with musk and warm woods. The result feels spicy, floral and slightly metallic, a rose perfume that reads bold and grown up. The 50ml size is easy to carry and a sensible way to get to know the house. As a unisex fragrance it wears well on anyone who enjoys a little drama.

If rose is your note, explore our floral fragrances. For more distinctive bottles from smaller and more creative houses, see niche perfume, or browse our wider unisex perfume edit.

Cleanse, tone and moisturise

Start with a wash suited to your skin: Deyga Vitamin C Foaming Face Wash, Vilvah Honey Face Wash or the Fragrance-Free Cream Face Wash. Next comes a face serum, such as Deyga 2% Hyaluronic Acid Serum, Rose Glow Serum or the 10% Vitamin C Face Serum, a vitamin c serum at £16.99. For a moisturiser for dry skin, Deyga Deep Moisturising Face Cream is a rich option, while Highborn London Imperial Moisturiser gives a richer, more luxurious texture. Oilier skin may prefer Deyga Light Moisturising Face Cream, made for oily and normal skin.

Masks, eyes and sun care

Face packs such as Spirulina Matcha Face Pack and Orange & Almond Face Pack Powder are mixed fresh for a weekly mask. Around the eyes, try Deyga Under Eye Mask or Highborn London Imperial Eye Gel, a lightweight alternative to a heavy under eye cream. Finish your morning with Vilvah Skin Finish Sunscreen SPF 50 PA+++, a sunscreen spf 50 with a light finish, or browse the full sun care edit.

Find a natural shampoo, conditioner or hair oil from our 29 haircare products by Vilvah and Deyga, with prices from £9.99. These Indian brands work with rice water, goat milk, soy milk, neem and traditional herbs. Swansura is an official UK partner of both, and we ship every order from the UK.

Wash and condition

Vilvah Goat Milk Shampoo is a gentle goat milk shampoo that cleanses without stripping, and pairs with Vilvah Cream Conditioner. Deyga Rice Water Shampoo, the rice water shampoo in our range, is made to improve hair texture and manageability, with Deyga Soy Milk Conditioner as its partner. For flakes, Vilvah Herbal Shampoo and Deyga Anti Dandruff Shampoo sit in our dandruff edit. Choosing a natural shampoo comes down to your scalp, so read each description before you buy.

Oils and treatments

Oiling before you wash is a long Indian tradition. Deyga Hair Growth Oil blends coconut, amla, hibiscus, castor and fenugreek, which makes it a good pick if you want an amla hair oil. Vilvah Hair Growth Oil uses pumpkin seed, kalonji and castor oils. Both are a popular hair growth oil choice for a weekly scalp massage, and you can see more in our hair fall edit. Deyga Premature Greying Hair Oil uses henna and bhringraj. For dry ends, Vilvah Goat Milk Hair Mask and Anti-Frizz Hair Serum add softness and smoothness.

Kits for an easy start

Vilvah's Goat Milk Hair Kit, Frizz Free Hair Kit and Anti-Dandruff Haircare Kit put matching products together, and any of them makes a thoughtful hair care gift set. Deyga's Daily Use Healthy Hair Kit is the lowest-priced kit at £11.99. You can also follow our Smooth & Shine and Hair Fall routines. Free UK delivery applies on orders over £40.

Arabian oud

Several Arabian houses use oud inside sweeter blends: try Afnan Supremacy Gold, Armaf Club de Nuit Intense or Lattafa for amber, coffee and spice.
